div.head: List of Persons
div.p: Editor’s Note. The identification of the persons in this list is generally limited to circumstances and positions under reference in this volume. Historical persons alluded to, officials noted in documents but not actively participating in substantive discussions, and individuals only mentioned in passing are not identified here. All titles and positions are American unless indicated otherwise. Where no dates are given, the official held the position throughout the period covered by this volume.
